method: requirements-check-1 (Sonnet 5 judge + Sonnet 5 check; disagreements unknown; quotes verified)

apiKey.keyFor: The AI copilot (Lens) needs a key for its model provider (default OpenAI); some translation engines (DeepL, Microsoft, Baidu, NiuTrans) and easyScholar rankings need keys
apiKey.worksWithout: Library visualization, reading analytics and Google translation (the default engine)

checkNote: README (模型接入) says: '支持 OpenAI / DeepSeek / 硅基流动 / Kimi / 智谱 / Ollama / LM Studio / 中转服务及 Anthropic'. The Lens model has a configurable baseURL ('baseURL:U("lens.baseURL","https://api.openai.com")'). So local Ollama and LM Studio are supported, and 'unknown' is wrong. The key answer 'optional' stands because the default Google translation engine needs no key.
